questions.question: How many seats are authorized on the board or committee, how many are currently filled, and how many vacancies exist?
questions.answer: The Conservation Commission is authorized to have seven appointed members plus two liaison members (nine total including liaisons). Currently, seven appointed members are listed: Haven Colgate (Chair), Eyal Dror, Matthew Hobby, Margie Lavender, Dan Lemons, Amy Listerman, and Aarthi Muthukrishnan, plus one liaison (Trustee Fleisig). No vacancies are explicitly stated, but only one of the two liaison positions appears filled. No current vacancy count is provided.
questions.shortAnswer: 7 appointed seats; 7 filled; vacancies not stated
questions.gap: The website lists authorized seats (7 appointed + 2 liaisons) and current members, but does not explicitly state the number of vacancies or confirm whether all appointed seats are filled. The second liaison seat status is unclear.

questions.answer: Yes. A link to the project page and the Protect Our Woods website is provided, along with a sign-up for work sessions.
